basic_info.description: Beautifully updated condo at Pacific Place. This unit boasts abundant natural light and features imported wide-plank wood flooring on the living area. The renovated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, and the open floor plan includes a primary bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and spacious double closets. The split-bedroom layout, complemented by two remodeled full bathrooms, offers flexibility for guests, roommates, or a dedicated home office. For added convenience, the unit also includes in-unit laundry and two private balconies overlooking a serene palm courtyard with a heated pool and spa.Pacific Place provides an array of amenities, including two lobbies, 24/7 security, on-site management, a gym, deeded parking, EV charger readiness, and additional storage. The building's prime location near Upper Polk, Fillmore, and Union Street offers easy access to boutique shops, diverse dining options, and charming cafes. With a remarkable Walk/Transit Score of 98, this unit is truly a must-see.
